question: Do I need a building permit for a home addition, and how do I get one?

nuggets.text: Enforcement of the Building Code is the local building department's responsibility.
nuggets.quote: Enforcement of the provisions of the Building Code for construction and rehabilitation shall be the responsibility of the local building department.

nuggets.text: The locality may levy fees to defray the cost of enforcement.
nuggets.quote: Fees may be levied by the local governing body in order to defray the cost of such enforcement and appeals.

nuggets.text: Decisions are appealed to the local board of building code appeals.
nuggets.quote: There shall be established within each local building department a local board of Building Code appeals whose composition, duties and responsibilities shall be prescribed in the Building Code.
